course_subtitle: Everything you need for your next class, together.
connect_description: Connect any school that supports the official Moodle mobile service.
connect_error: Could not connect. Try signing in again.
sign_in_hint: Sign-in continues in a secure school window. VStudy never asks for your school password here.
all_caught_up: Nothing due in the next seven days. You have room to get ahead.
action_error: That action could not be completed. Please try again.
offline_stale: Could not refresh. Showing your last synced courses.
load_error: Your courses could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
disconnect_removes: Removed from this computer: the saved sign-in, the synced course list, deadlines, grades, updates and reminders, and your chats inside its courses.
disconnect_keeps: Kept: your planner tasks, goals and exams (they just lose their course link), documents you imported and their chats, and your study material. Reconnect any time to sync again.
expired: Your school session has expired. Reconnect to keep courses up to date.
no_grades: Grades will appear here when your teacher publishes them.
files_hint: Open a file to read, annotate, and explore it with your document assistant.
no_files: No files in this course yet.
no_deadlines: No deadlines here. Take a breath.
no_notifications: You are all caught up with course updates.
empty_description: Connect your school to see courses, deadlines, and files in one place.
set_reminder: Remind me before it is due
future_time: Choose a time in the future.
prepare_description: Make sense of course updates and turn your next deadline into a plan.
explain_prepare: Explain what I need to prepare
agent_unavailable: Enable a chat provider in Settings to start a course conversation.
agent_scope: Scoped to this course. Suggested actions always need your approval.
site_address_hint: Paste your Moodle address, including a subdirectory if your school uses one.
site_check_error: Could not find a supported Moodle site. Check the address and your connection. Only public HTTPS sites are supported.
presets_error: Suggestions are unavailable. You can still enter your school URL.
method_password: Sign in with your Moodle username and password
method_browser: Sign in through your school’s browser login
method_embedded: Sign in through your school’s secure login window
password_hint: Your password is sent to this Moodle site for sign-in and is not saved.
auth_invalidlogin: The username or password was not accepted. Try again.
auth_usernotfullysetup: Complete your account setup on your school’s Moodle website first.
auth_webservices-disabled: Ask your school administrator to enable Moodle web services.
auth_requirecorrectaccess: This account or token does not match the selected school and user. Sign in with the original account.
auth_sso-required: Your school requires browser sign-in. Continue in the school window.
auth_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
unavailable_maintenance: Your school’s Moodle is under maintenance.
next_maintenance: Try again after your school completes maintenance.
next_webservices-disabled: Ask your administrator to enable web services in Moodle.
unavailable_mobile-disabled: The Moodle mobile service is disabled.
next_mobile-disabled: Ask your administrator to enable the official Moodle mobile web service.
unavailable_unsupported-version: This Moodle version is not supported.
next_unsupported-version: VStudy needs Moodle 3.5 or later. Ask your school about upgrading.
auth_timeout: Sign-in timed out. Please try again.
auth_callback-invalid: The school returned an invalid sign-in response. Please try again.
auth_load-failed: The sign-in page could not load. Check your connection and retry.
auth_blocked: The sign-in page was blocked because its address is unsafe.
auth_disposed: Sign-in stopped because the app is shutting down.
waiting_embedded: Complete sign-in in the sign-in window.
activity_details: See Moodle for full activity details and submissions.
keychain_hint: macOS may ask for your Mac password to protect your sign-in. Choose Always Allow.
keychain_error: Secure storage was denied or is unavailable. Retry, or connect for this session only. Your sign-in will clear when you quit.
keychain_unsaved: Could not save your sign-in securely. You are connected for this session. Retry saving without signing in again.
media_notice: Some pictures, video or sound are hidden here. Open this activity in Moodle to see everything.
link_failed: Could not open this link. Try opening the activity in Moodle.
updates_shortcuts: ↑ ↓ Move · Enter Open · M Mark read or unread
